mentions.name: RoastTrack
mentions.description: This cooking timer app plans roasting multiple dishes at once: users pick items like chicken legs, sweet potato, and green beans, and it produces a simple schedule telling them when to put each item in, flip it, and take it out.
mentions.problem: Roasting several foods at the same time requires mental arithmetic to coordinate when to start, flip, and remove each dish.
mentions.audience: Home cooks who want to roast multiple dishes at once and eat more home-cooked veggies
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a cooking timer that solves the mental arithmetic of roasting multiple things at once. Pick chicken legs, sweet potato, green beans, etc and it'll give you a simple plan telling you when to put things in, flip them and take them out.

evidence.value: I built a cooking timer that solves the mental arithmetic of roasting multiple things at once. Pick chicken legs, sweet potato, green beans, etc and it'll give you a simple plan telling you when to put things in, flip them and take them out.
